decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion authority contrary to the specification; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII input, casefold satisfies lowercase normalization; diff check and committed test pass.
Non-empty behavior passes, but empty-sequence behavior is unspecified, so preservation of its intended behavior cannot be validated.
Candidate returns zero instead of raising ConfigError for invalid input; the malformed-input test fails.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the committed test fails.

strategy_update: Continue using exact diffs and committed tests, while abstaining when a material claim depends on explicitly unspecified behavior.
